name: Atlanta
intro: Atlanta got its first Michelin stars in 2023, in the MICHELIN Guide Atlanta, which became part of the MICHELIN Guide American South in 2025. More than half of the city’s starred restaurants are Japanese omakase counters; Spring, in Marietta, is on the Georgia page. Prices are in US dollars, per person before tax and tip (or the service charge some restaurants add), checked October 2026.
